product.name: Pololu Multi-Hub Wheel w/Inserts for 3mm and 4mm Shafts - 80×10mm, Black, 2-Pack

warnings: Only the 80 mm diameter and 10 mm width are stated, and the listing marks them as unverified. The central bore diameter (9 mm) is a rough scale estimate from the photo, not a printed value. The hub has additional small holes around the bore, and the images show no printed dimensions for them, so I left them out. The 3 mm and 4 mm collet inserts (round and D-shaped) fit into the hub. The images give no collet dimensions, and the listing gives no shaft or bore dimensions. The wheel's overall z extent assumes the 10 mm width covers the whole tire and hub.
The 80 mm diameter and 10 mm width are stated in the listing but marked unverified.
The 9 mm bore comes from a rough scale estimate of the photo, not a printed value.
The hub radius, spoke width and thickness, rim and tire thicknesses, and the 6 mm disc thickness are all estimated from the photo.
The small holes around the hub bore were omitted because their sizes are uncertain.
The collet inserts, the screws, the metal triangular mounting plates and the tire/rim split were not modeled. The wheel is a single solid.
The wheel axis is along Y to satisfy the placement rules, although the image analysis gave the axis as Z.
